api_samples.name: CMS Part D Prescribers by Provider & Drug (2024)
api_samples.loop: Paged 5,000 rows at a time for each of 62 diabetes generic names, 8 requests in parallel
api_samples.one_row: One prescriber × one drug: that prescriber's 2024 Medicare claims for it

api_samples.name: CMS Part D Spending by Drug (2020–2024)
api_samples.loop: One paged pull of all 3,625 brands, then kept the 142 diabetes brands
api_samples.one_row: One brand: national Medicare spending, claims and patients for each year 2020–2024

api_samples.name: CMS Part D Prescribers by Geography & Drug (2024)
api_samples.loop: One request per diabetes generic name (62)
api_samples.one_row: One state × one brand: total prescribers, claims and cost

api_samples.name: CDC PLACES county data (2025 release)
api_samples.loop: One request; Socrata query language does the filtering server-side
api_samples.one_row: One county: % of adults with diagnosed diabetes and obesity (survey-based model estimates)

api_samples.name: NLM RxClass (ATC classes)

api_samples.name: openFDA Drugs@FDA
